summary: The customer wants to assess whether a fiber-based optical measurement in a tablet press feed frame can monitor API concentration changes in a powder blend.

facts_stated.text: Tablets are manufactured from a powder blend containing an API and excipients.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We manufacture tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.

facts_stated.text: Laboratory checks currently provide on-target results after the material has passed through the press.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Laboratory checks tell us whether the blend is on target, but results arrive after the material has moved through the press.

facts_stated.text: The customer wants to test fiber-based measurement in the feed frame.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We want to assess whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes.

facts_stated.text: The first pilot will compare measurement options before committing to production equipment.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options before we commit to production equipment.

targets.purpose: follow concentration changes in the powder blend

heterogeneous.enquiry_quote: powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients

customer_premises.claim: A fiber-based measurement in the feed frame can successfully follow API concentration changes.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes

unknowns: Target API concentration range and required precision
Feed frame geometry and optical interface / probe design
Process temperature and powder flow dynamics
